dedup.note: The fresh pending_workers root and jobs tree were read at baseline. The GitHub connector truncates the complete historical jobs tree/blob corpus by response size, so a physical blob-by-blob read of every historical pending file could not be verified in this runtime. Repo-wide exact-key search, including pending paths, was performed before deep-check and repeated immediately before staging for INN, OGRN, exact legal name and confirmed brand+domain.

Only directly visible distinct employers were counted. Волжанка was not promoted because the vacancy/brand-to-current legal-entity mapping was not clean enough for strict employer-level staging.
Distinct visible employer names were cheap-gated; anonymous/confidential employers and weak entity mappings were not promoted.
Distinct visible employers were counted conservatively; no candidate with cleaner evidence than the final Ufa lead was promoted.

НПП Авиатрон and НПФ ГКС reached deep-check. НПП Авиатрон was not staged because the strongest exact-dated vacancy evidence had an expiry date of 2026-08-28; НПФ ГКС had a current August listing and passed all strict gates.
